model_annotations.Bulgarian: This plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output with a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers. The x-axis represents the layer, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, and no units are specified. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0. There are three lines in the plot: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate, an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate, and a green solid line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate. The blue line starts at approximately 0.15 and decreases to around 0.01, remaining relatively stable from layer 5 onwards. The orange line starts at around 0.95 and decreases to approximately 0.25, with some fluctuations from layer 10 onwards. The green line starts at around 0.95 and decreases to approximately 0.15, with some minor fluctuations throughout.
model_annotations.Chinese: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output with a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", is a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 23, and tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 5, with units of layer number. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio", is also a linear scale with a value range of 0.0 to 1.0, and tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate, an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate, and a green solid line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate. The blue line starts at approximately 0.15 and decreases to around 0.005, remaining relatively stable from layer 5 onwards. The orange line starts at 0.95 and decreases to around 0.2, with fluctuations between layers 15 and 23. The green line starts at 0.95 and decreases to around 0.15, with some fluctuations. Notably, at layer 0, the orange and green lines have a sparsity ratio of nearly 1.0, while the blue line has a ratio of about 0.15; at layer 23, the blue line has a ratio of approximately 0.005, the orange line around 0.35, and the green line around 0.1.
model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", is on a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 23, and tick labels are spaced at regular intervals of 5, with units of layers. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio", is also on a linear scale with a value range of 0 to 1.0, and tick labels are spaced at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate, an orange dotted line for the sparsity ratio after gate, and a green dash-dot line for the sparsity ratio after average gate. The blue line starts at approximately 0.15 and decreases to near 0 by layer 5, remaining near 0 through layer 23. The orange line starts at around 0.95 and decreases to about 0.25 by layer 5, then fluctuates, reaching 0.35 at layer 23. The green line begins at 0.95 and decreases to about 0.3 by layer 5, then slightly increases and fluctuates, ending at approximately 0.25 by layer 23.
model_annotations.German: Das Liniendiagramm zeigt den Sparsity Ratio von SDPA-Ausgaben bei einem Schwellenwert von 1e-2 über verschiedene Schichten. Die x-Achse ist beschriftet mit "Layer" und hat einen linearen Maßstab mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis 23, die Einheitsbezeichnung fehlt und die Ticks sind bei jedem ganzzahligen Wert beschriftet. Die y-Achse ist beschriftet mit "Sparsity Ratio" und hat einen linearen Maßstab mit einem Wertebereich von 0 bis 1.0, die Einheitsbezeichnung fehlt und die Ticks sind bei jedem 0.2-Wert beschriftet. Es sind drei Linien dargestellt: eine blaue gestrichelte Linie für den Sparsity Ratio vor dem Gate mit einem Durchschnittswert von 0,03, eine orange gepunktete Linie für den Sparsity Ratio nach dem Gate mit einem Durchschnittswert von 0,44 und eine grüne gestrichelte Linie für den Sparsity Ratio nach dem Average Gate mit einem Durchschnittswert von 0,33. Die blaue Linie beginnt bei etwa 0,15 und nimmt bis Schicht 5 auf etwa 0,05 ab, um dann auf etwa 0,0 bis Schicht 23 zu fallen. Die orange Linie beginnt bei etwa 0,95 und fällt auf etwa 0,35 bis Schicht 23, mit einem leichten Anstieg zwischen den Schichten 18 und 23. Die grüne Linie beginnt bei etwa 1,0 und fällt auf etwa 0,2 bis Schicht 23, mit kleinen Schwankungen.
